# Manojit Ballav - Principal Product Manager

> Manojit Ballav (also known as Mono) is a Principal Product Manager at Lumio (Circuit House Technologies), Bengaluru, India. Former Xiaomi India product leader (2017–2024). Works on home projectors, smart TVs, connected devices and the internal systems that run a consumer electronics company.

## About

Manojit Ballav (Mono) is a Principal Product Manager at Lumio, an Indian consumer electronics company making smart TVs and home projectors, founded in 2024 by former Xiaomi India executives.

At Lumio:
- Leads the projector line, including the Lumio Arc series (India's No. 1 Google TV projector), and new product categories
- Built TLDR, Lumio's content discovery platform, from first version through its redesign, then handed it to another product manager
- Builds Lumio's internal systems across manufacturing, sales and channel operations, after-sales service and business analytics

At Xiaomi India (2017–2024):
- Helped build India's No. 1 smart TV brand (22 consecutive quarters, Q2 2018 – Q3 2023)
- Helped build PatchWall, a smart TV content aggregation platform with 6M+ monthly active users
- Managed Xiaomi and Redmi Smart TVs, streaming devices and soundbars
- Product manager for the Xiaomi Pad 6 in India
- Led the Xiaomi HyperOS program in India: user awareness, media briefings, and on-schedule device upgrades
- Earlier hands-on work on connected devices: QA for Mi Router 3C, audio tuning for Redmi Buds and Mi True Wireless Earphones 2

Totals: 34 products launched, 12M+ devices sold, 30+ OTT and content partnerships.
Research: co-author, "Application of IoT in detecting health risks due to flickering artificial lights", IEEE ICACCI 2015, DOI 10.1109/ICACCI.2015.7275966.

Areas of expertise:
- Smart TV product development and panel evaluation
- Connected TV (CTV) and streaming platforms
- AI-powered advertising and personalization
- FAST (Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV) channels
- Display technologies (TN, IPS, VA, Mini LED, QLED, OLED, QD-OLED, Tandem OLED, MicroLED, QDEL)
- TV panel selection and optimization for Indian market conditions

## Key Topics & Expertise

- Lumio Smart TVs: Vision 9 QD-Mini LED (₹59,999), Vision 7 QLED (₹27,999–₹36,999), Vision Arc projectors
- Lumio products available on Amazon.in, Flipkart, and lumio.co.in
- TV display panel technology: backlit (TN, IPS, VA, LED, Mini LED, Quantum Dots) and self-emissive (OLED, QD-OLED, Tandem OLED, MicroLED, QDEL)
- Panel evaluation and supplier selection for Indian conditions (humidity, ambient light, heat)
- CTV industry trends and market analysis
- AI in CTV advertising
- FAST channels in India
- TV display technology comparisons
- Projector types and buying guide for India
- Indian Smart TV market ($22B+ market)
- Product Management in consumer electronics

- [Lumio Arc 7 2026 vs Arc 7: What Changed, and Why We Built a New One](/blog/lumio-arc-7-2026-vs-arc-7.html): Arc Light Engine 2, 500 ANSI lumens (from 400), 1700:1 contrast, 45.76% DCI-P3, 45-120 inch image, Google TV with Gemini, Rs 34,999. How LCD light engines are getting brighter

- [Every Google Certified Android Device in One Searchable Database](/blog/google-certified-devices.html): 50,000+ Google certified (GMS) Android devices across 3,700+ brands, searchable by model and brand, updated daily
- [20,000-Hour LED Projector Lifespan: The Specification That Doesn't Tell the Whole Story](/blog/led-projector-lifespan.html): LED lamp hours vs lumen maintenance, and why LCD panels and polarizers age faster than the light source
- [Why LED Lumens Are Misleading: What Projector Brightness Ratings Actually Mean](/blog/led-lumens-misleading.html): Optical losses in LCD projectors cut on-screen brightness by up to 90% versus the quoted LED lumens
- [TV Display Panels Explained: From TN to MicroLED](/blog/tv-panel-types.html): Deep technical breakdown of every TV display panel type. How Lumio picks panels for Indian conditions

- [Building Lumio: My Journey from Xiaomi to India's Next Smart TV Revolution](/blog/blog-lumio-journey.html): The story behind Lumio and Circuit House Technologies
- [The State of CTV in 2025](/blog/blog-ctv-trends-2025.html): CTV accounts for 44.8% of TV viewership, surpassing broadcast and cable
- [How AI is Transforming CTV Advertising](/blog/blog-ai-ctv-advertising.html): AI enables 8x ROI on personalized marketing
